sample_product_faq.md::1.text:
How much storage do I get on the free plan?
The free plan includes 5GB of storage and supports files up to 2GB each.

sample_product_faq.md::2.text:
Can I share a folder with someone who doesn't have an Acme account?
Yes. Any folder can be shared via a public link. The recipient can view
and

sample_product_faq.md::3.text:
download files without creating an account, but they cannot upload
or edit unless you invite them as a collaborator with an Acme account.

sample_product_faq.md::4.text:
Does Acme support two-factor authentication?
Yes, via an authenticator app (TOTP) or SMS. Two-factor authentication
can be enabled from Account

sample_product_faq.md::5.text:
Settings > Security, and is required by
default for all Business and Enterprise plans.

sample_product_faq.md::6.text:
What happens to my files if I downgrade from a paid plan?
If your paid plan is storing more data than your new plan's limit, your
account is put

sample_product_faq.md::7.text:
into read-only mode: you can download and delete files,
but you cannot upload new ones, until your usage is back under the new
plan's storage

sample_product_faq.md::9.text:

# Acme Cloud Storage — Refund Policy

Acme Cloud Storage offers a 14-day money-back guarantee on all new paid
subscriptions. Refund requests must be

sample_refund_policy.md::1.text:
submitted through the account
billing page within 14 calendar days of the initial charge.

Refunds are issued to the original payment method and

sample_refund_policy.md::2.text:
typically appear
within 5-10 business days, depending on the card issuer or bank.

Digital add-ons purchased separately from the base subscription

sample_refund_policy.md::3.text:
(extra
storage blocks, priority support add-ons) are non-refundable once
provisioned, because the additional capacity is allocated immediately
and

sample_refund_policy.md::4.text:
cannot be reclaimed.

Annual plans downgraded mid-cycle are not eligible for a prorated refund
of the unused period; customers can instead let the

sample_refund_policy.md::5.text:
plan run out and
choose not to renew.

Enterprise contracts follow the refund terms specified in the signed
order form rather than this self-serve

sample_refund_policy.md::6.text:
policy — contact your account
manager for enterprise refund requests.
